id: title:carlos-marchal-ph:gate white labelling behind the enterprise feature in feedback wizard

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a feature availability guard to the white-label configuration UI, preventing users from enabling white-labeling unless the underlying feature is available.
review.reason: The change adds a dependency on the `upgradeModalLogic` and its `guardAvailableFeature` action to the white-label configuration component. This implements a guard that checks if the `WHITE_LABELLING` feature is available before allowing the user to toggle the white-label setting. This is a localized, bounded implementation of a feature availability check.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation of a guard. The score does not account for unverified outcomes such as whether the feature is actually available, whether the guard prevents the action, or the actual user benefit. No tier 2 or 3 evidence is present.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a frontend React component change. No score assigned. No tier assigned.
